candidate_relations.reason: The histopathology and immunohistochemistry results (CD33+, CD123+, CD4+, CD163+, negative for S100 and CD1a which are markers for Langerhans cells) are inconsistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis and instead point towards a myeloid lineage, specifically juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) with cutaneous involvement (leukemia cutis).
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Langerhans cell histiocytosis vs. leukemia cutis secondary to JMML
